title: Bifrost v2.2.3 installed-version behaviour characterization (disposable store)
secrets: none (values are env.<NAME> references or dummy non-secret sentinels; masked by the gateway itself)

method.isolation: disposable copy of the known-good reference store under /tmp/opencode/bifrost-lab; CWD == app-dir; loopback-only; ephemeral port; never touched /var/lib/company-os
method.note_cwd: Bifrost resolves config_store path './config.db' relative to the PROCESS CWD, not -app-dir. The live unit sets WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/company-os/bifrost/data so they coincide; the lab mirrors this.

t1_fresh_store_seed_from_config_json.meaning: A missing store is seeded from config.json.

t2_existing_store_reconcile_from_config_.input: existing 8-provider db + config.json with 'cerebras' added, then config.json with 'groq' removed
t2_existing_store_reconcile_from_config_.meaning: On an existing store, startup reconciles config.json ADDITIVELY: providers present in config.json but missing from the store are added; providers removed from config.json are NOT removed. config.json is an additive seed, not a destructive mirror.

t3_authentication_enforcement.meaning: Auth is governed by config.json governance.auth_config.is_enabled at startup. With it false (the live state) the management API is unauthenticated for READS AND WRITES.

POST /api/providers/{p}/keys repeat iden.error: API key names must be unique across providers. Choose a different name

POST /api/providers/{p}/keys literal (no.note: literal secret values are ACCEPTED by the API - the caller must pass env.<NAME> refs

t4_management_api_write_contract.meaning: Contract: create provider with {'provider': name}; create key with {name,value:'env.<NAME>',models,weight}. Duplicate provider/key are rejected (409) - safe, but a retry must treat 409 as already-exists.

t5_management_api_provider_registry_limi.input: for each id: POST /api/providers {'provider':id} then POST /api/providers/{id}/keys {value:'env.PROBE'}

key_create_500.nvidia: failed to create provider for the given key: unsupported provider: nvidia
key_create_500.zai: failed to create provider for the given key: unsupported provider: zai
key_create_500.cloudflare: failed to create provider for the given key: unsupported provider: cloudflare

t5_management_api_provider_registry_limi.meaning: Provider-create always returns 200 (the name is stored) but key-create only works for ids in the API's internal registry. The API CANNOT add nvidia/zai/cloudflare - it can complete at most 3 of 6. The approved API-only method is therefore insufficient.

t6_config_json_additive_seed_restores_al.input: disposable store that mirrors live (mistral only, no config.json) -> write config.json with mistral + the six approved providers (openai excluded) -> restart
t6_config_json_additive_seed_restores_al.meaning: The config.json additive seed restores ALL SIX providers and their keys, including the three the API rejects, and preserves mistral. This is the validated restoration method.

t7_authentication_mechanism.struct_from_binary: governance.auth_config = { is_enabled bool; admin_username SecretVar; admin_password SecretVar }
t7_authentication_mechanism.seed_precedence: config.json seeds a value only where the store lacks it; a store whose DB already had is_auth_enabled=true ignored config.json is_enabled=false (restored-reference start returned 401). Live store has NO auth_config (live GET /api/config lacks it) => the seed applies on live.
t7_authentication_mechanism.runtime_writer: PUT /api/config exists (UI save path); rejects partial bodies (400 log_retention_days must be at least 1); exact schema not fully resolved; not used.

t8_backup_restore_procedure.method: python sqlite3 Connection.backup() (sqlite3 CLI not installed); source opened mode=ro; service not stopped; live DB not modified
t8_backup_restore_procedure.finding_encryption_key_dependency: reference keys are encrypted => restoring such a store requires BIFROST_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Restored-reference gateway returned 401 (its DB had auth enabled), not a restore failure.
t8_backup_restore_procedure.live_relevance: LIVE keys are plain_text env refs => live restore is not key-dependent; still retain the encryption key in backup.

live_state_readonly.app_dir_config_json: ABSENT - journal 'config file not found at path: /var/lib/company-os/bifrost/data/config.json, initializing with default values'
live_state_readonly.admin_account: ABSENT - journal 'No admin account is configured for this Bifrost instance yet, and no setup token is configured.'
live_state_readonly.note: Live store was initialized from defaults; mistral was auto-detected from the MISTRAL_API_KEY env var delivered via systemd LoadCredential. The reference store's other providers were never seeded into the new app-dir.
